Function Spaces: Cc, C0, Cb

This scene is about function spaces. See how the three families of continuous functions CcC_cCc​, C0C_0C0​, and CbC_bCb​ nest and split.

CbC_bCb​ is all bounded continuous functions. C0C_0C0​ holds the ones that fade to 000 far away, and CcC_cCc​ the ones that are exactly 000 outside a finite interval. Both inclusions Cc⊂C0⊂CbC_c \subset C_0 \subset C_bCc​⊂C0​⊂Cb​ are strict.

For example, a ⛺ tent stands on a finite patch of ground. Fog thins out with distance but lies everywhere. An endless plain never fades away at all.
